Anja Hohenester-Zimmern do you know if the interview is at the same time as the last A5 appointment? We were given the citizenship application forms at our last A5 renewal and given a date to submit them that roughly coincides with when my current A5 visa will expire (I will have been on A5 then for 3 years, 10 months). 

Or should I expect a standard A5 interview when I submit them and an additional citizenship interview after that at a later date?
